name: Console8
purpose: Console-channel colour: subtle analog-style texture (defined lows, softened top, solid depth) as if through a good desk; raise Drive for smooth saturation. A 'secret sauce' late in a vocal chain, before reverb.
avoid_for: material that must stay completely untouched

params.name: Tone
params.ai_hint: Solid: tough, physical, grounded. Hype: softer and more ethereal, with the presence band sticking out; a good finish for a dull or dense vocal.

params.name: Drive
params.ai_hint: 0 is clean texture only, 20-40 adds warmth and density, 60-100 is obvious smooth saturation and gets louder. Back the level off with later modules if it rises.

notes: Written against Airwindows Console8: Console8ChannelIn (or Console8ChannelHype) followed by Console8ChannelOut. In the original, In starts a channel and Out ends it with the other processing between them; Plugsalot runs them back to back as one stage.
Drive is the Out plugin's fader: 0% is unity, 100% is 6 dB of gain into each of its two sine-shaped stages (about 12 dB total) before they soft-clip.
Console8 expects clean, low-level inputs; it works best late in a chain on a well-levelled signal.
CPU: 0.79% of one core at 48 kHz on Plugsalot's 2-core build machine (plugin/tests/TestMain.cpp); 1 point per 2%, minimum 1.
